Git status is clean. Now let's run ddev start. This will pull images (large) and may take a while. The 600s timeout per command may be an issue. Let me try ddev start with a longer approach — I can run it in background and poll. But first let's just try.

Actually, ddev start needs the mkcert and ddev-hostname binaries on PATH, and possibly dependencies. Let me set PATH in the su command. Also set DDEV_NO_INSTRUMENTATION perhaps.

Let me run ddev start in the workspace. It might take >600s pulling images. Let me start it in background with nohup and poll.

action.command: su ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin && nohup ddev start > /tmp/ddev_start.log 2>&1 & echo "PID $!"'; sleep 20; tail -30 /tmp/ddev_start.log
